title: Alliances pocket daily log
body:
Daily scratch — quick handheld notes for alliance ops (super informal)

2026-03-13 morning check (07:45 PT)
- Top priority: finish Partner A onboarding checklist items so they can run smoke tests on staging next week.
- Quick wins: confirm SSO metadata, share sample inference request schema, confirm billing contact.

Morning inbox triage:
- PARTNERS-321: need to confirm rate-limit defaults for integration. Action: ping Ethan, ask for expected 95th percentile. (ETA: today EOD)
- Email from Partner B: they want earlier callback on webhooks. Note: hook retries are currently 30s/5 attempts. Follow-up: ask infra if we can expose retry policy to partners.

Integration checklist (working, not final) — tick when done:
- [ ] SSO metadata + certs received and validated
- [x] Sandbox API key provisioned on partner account (created 2026-03-12)
- [ ] Sample payload and error semantics doc shared
- [ ] Rate limit expectations documented (internal)
- [ ] Webhook retry policy decision (internal)
- [ ] Pricing T&Cs draft sent to finance
- [ ] Smoke test script pushed to partner-infra repo (PR #88)

Notes-to-self:
- When sending sample payload, include small and large context examples (one with ~64 tokens, one with ~2048) so partner sees perf differences.
- Add a note in Confluence about per-route caching behavior; partner asked about caching across shared prefix.

Meeting with Partner A (10:00 PT) — prep bullets:
- Ask about peak qps for list endpoints; want 99th p95 latency target of <= 250ms
- Confirm rollout plan: start with 10% traffic (canary) -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days
- Offer dedicated capacity option if they need predictable throughput (mention SLA and cost)
- Ask whether they will need Private (VPC) deployment — if yes, tag to infra for early scoping

Follow-ups after 10:00 meeting (to assign):
- Sofia: scope SSO cert rotation automation (due 2026-03-18)
- Ethan: quantify rate-limit headroom and propose default policy (due 2026-03-15)
- Me (Maya): push sample payloads + small README to PR #88 and notify partner

Blockers / open questions:
- Does SRE approve exposing retry-policy controls to partners? Risk: misconfiguration could increase load. (Slack thread: #infra-partners, see yesterday)
- Need clarity on billing contact for Partner A — finance requires a named PO contact before enabling Dedicated trials.

Quick log of small decisions:  
- Decided to keep default retry backoff (30s) for now; recommend partner set a jittered backoff.
- Will include a short paragraph on quantization profiles in the sample payload README to warn partners about response variability at lower precisions.

Micro-tasks (estimated times):
- Draft payload README (20–30m) — DONE
- Push PR with smoke script and example requests (45m) — in progress
- Compose email to Partner B about webhook retries and expected delivery semantics (10m) — TODO
- Quick call with finance to get PO contact (15m) — schedule after lunch

Snippets / templates to reuse:
- "We recommend starting at 5 qps with a 2x burst capacity; if you see sustained queuing, contact us and we can provision dedicated capacity."
- Sample error doc link placeholder: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ALL/Error+Codes+for+Partner+Integrations

Random notes / brain dump:
- Would be nice to build a tiny UI for partners to preview their rate limit and retry settings (configurable). Low priority MVP though.
- Consider short FAQ for marketplace: "How do I test latency?" -> suggest two sample payload sizes + guidance on variance and quantization effects.

End-of-day checklist (tomorrow morning self-check):
- Confirm PARTNERS-321 update from Ethan
- Merge PR #88 if QA passes
- Follow up with finance on PO

Tiny log entries:  
- 07:50 — skim inbox, flagged PARTNERS-321
- 08:30 — created sandbox key for Partner A
- 09:05 — quick sync with Sofia re: SSO certs

If I forget everything: note to self -> put the partner's billing contact and SSO expiration in a single line in the Confluence onboarding checklists so renewals don't slip.

---
Revision history:
- 2026-03-12: created quick skeleton, added initial checklist
- 2026-03-13: fleshed out meeting prep, assigned follow-ups, marked sandbox key as provisioned

End of pocket log.
